intro.text: A nobleman in Luthadel with a deep contempt for skaa.

items.text: At a ball at Keep Hasting he joined Vin, Kliss, Milen Davenpleu and others discussing recent events, adding little but a badly received joke about Ardous Geffenry's death. He grew very upset when Kliss mentioned skaa thieves; his wife Carlee hinted that he had once been scammed by a thieving crew.

personality.text: Despises skaa, and Vin suspects he would abuse or kill them without remorse. He isn't very clever, and his humour would have suited Camon's crew better than the nobility.
His young wife Carlee often mocks his mistakes in public. He plays shelldry regularly with Milen, Rene and another noble.
